name: calmathx
description: CalMathX (CMX): step-by-step algebra and Calculus 1-3 solver (MERN + SymPy)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && python -m pip install -r server/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
